ns2:section.sectionText: 2ND EIGHT WEEKS: Registration for this course will close at 9 AM on the first day of instruction. No overrides will be given after that time. It may take 2 - 3 hours after registering for you to have access to the course on Canvas. This course will require an additional fee to access the Cengage online resources (including the e-textbook) necessary to complete all module tasks. Details related to the fee structure will be posted on Canvas. Day1Access course materials cost $75.09. For more information see https://go.illinois.edu/Day1Access.
